caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden clock with dark brown vertical columns on either side and a decorative curved pediment with a black and gold design at the top. The clock face is situated in the upper section and is circular with black Roman numerals, black clock hands, and a floral motif featuring pink and white roses with green leaves around the center. Beneath the clock face, there is a rectangular panel bordered by a teal-blue design resembling stylized leaves; inside this panel, there is a framed painting showing a small brown watermill building with a waterwheel next to a river, surrounded by green trees and bushes under a blue sky. The entire clock has a wooden exterior frame with visible grain, and the drawing is rendered on a light beige background.
title: Shelf Clock
